'''Jonasim''' was a former queen of [[Saldaea]].

== History ==
Her son nearly gambled away the House fortune. She was known as a great monarch.
== Trivia ==
* Jonasim is named for Jonathan Sim, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
